findings.message: Every `refresh()` reloads `clutch_app_config` get and writes the result into every config input. This diff also makes `refresh()` run every `refreshSeconds` (default 15) and on window focus. So if an operator changes a value such as `Parallel max runs` and does not click Save within one poll, the input is reset to the on-disk value. Save config.yaml then sends the old value and the edit is silently lost.
findings.paved_road: Only fill the config inputs when the operator has nothing unsaved. For example, mark an input dirty on its `input`/`change` event, skip dirty inputs (or skip filling entirely) during `refresh()`, and clear the dirty flags after Save config.yaml succeeds. Add a harness case: edit an input, fire the interval callback, then assert the edited value survives and is what Save sends.
